execution.input: coordinator verifies ZIPs once and sends decoded training ECGs to workers
execution.output: coordinator commits atomic per-record feature checkpoints; each worker logs its own VMD attempts
execution.run_lock: exclusive OS file lock; released automatically after process exit
execution.failure_policy: stop submitting work on first failure, retain results from already running records, log and fail the stage

pilot.selection: smallest SHA-256 of scientific protocol id plus colon plus record id among fit records; labels unused
pilot.comparison: exact equality of both feature vectors, names, physical input hash, VMD attempts, iterations and limits
pilot.kymatio_reference: both serial comparison records at frozen settings

full_run.scope: eligible official-training ECGs only; fit plus internal validation
